name: Kipling
notes: US store meta: Savannah, Georgia, USD, ships to 28 countries incl. US, CA, GB, AU (https://us.kipling.com/meta.json). Story: in 1987 'three Antwerp-based designers discovered crinkle nylon', a 'featherlight, durable, and water-resistant material'; signature furry monkey keychain on its bags (https://us.kipling.com/pages/our-story). hq_country BE reflects that Antwerp origin.

Free shipping on all U.S. orders $99 or more (https://us.kipling.com/pages/shipping). Returns of new, unused items within 30 days of purchase, $8.95 fee deducted; no exchanges (https://us.kipling.com/pages/returns-kip).

Named: Gabbie Small Crossbody Bag $109 (multiple zip pockets), Seoul Large 15" Laptop Backpack $134 ('Our best-selling backpack', laptop sleeve), Afia Lite Mini Crossbody Bag $24 (foldable, packable), Delia Medium Backpack $169. Whole-store feed filtered to bag product types; 285 bag listings marked down excluded.

Mix of the 431 regular-price bags counted (2026-10-29): 110 crossbodies, 94 shoulder bags, 160 backpacks (laptop, fashion, small, mini), 47 totes, 18 mini bags. Story: 'Each and every monkey in a color family has a unique name' (https://us.kipling.com/products.json?limit=250, https://us.kipling.com/pages/our-story).
